# Czech Republic

Region: Europe. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Czech Banking Association (CBA)

**Role:** National banking-association format standard publisher

**Reporting coverage:** Detailed national customer-bank reporting, schemas and examples

**Messages / versions:** camt.053.001.08; camt.052.001.02 (legacy national profile); camt.086 (legacy national fees profile); pain.001.001.09; pain.002.001.10; pain.008.001.08

- [National XML formats and archive](https://www.cbaonline.cz/clanky/formaty-xml-pro-vzajemnou-komunikaci-bank-s-klienty) — specification; public-page
- [CBA ISO2019 national standard v2026_1_00,15Jul2026](https://cbaonline.cz/journal_files_storage/cba-xml-rel2019_v2026_1_00.xlsx) — specification; public-file
- [CZ CBA camt05308 XSD](https://cbaonline.cz/journal_files_storage/cz_cba_camt05300108.xsd) — specification; public-file
- [camt053 national example](https://cbaonline.cz/journal_files_storage/camt053_vypis.xml) — sample-file; public-file
- [camt052 national example2018](https://cbaonline.cz/journal_files_storage/820-camt052cz-vzorovy-obrat-v2018.xml) — sample-file; public-file

Current landing content embedded as JSON; normal shell HTTP fetch verified. New15Jul2026 standard adopts ISO2019. It says archived camt052 and086 remain valid pending updates. Many older archive URLs point to test.awebsys.cz host; those were not fetched as primary examples. No redistribution permission inferred.
